Oxygen saturation (SpO2) / Fraction of Inspired Oxygen (FiO2) X Respiratory rate (RR)

Range for RR : 12/min – 70/min)


As is obvious, the higher the index, the better is the chance of success.

The application is based on the scientific research. It helps to determine the fertile days of the month, so you can either achieve or avoid pregnancy. * Scientific Research *

The popular baby gender prediction method is used by default. But it’s based only on the widely-spread theory by Landrum Shettles. You can change the gender prediction method on the “Settings” screen. But remember that either gender prediction method shows only slightly higher chances of conceiving a girl or a boy and it never guarantees the result.

This is the full version of the application. You will be able to see the following data:

- The probability of getting pregnant on the current or on any selected day.

- Chances of conceiving a girl or a boy during the current period.

- Length of the luteal phase (most women can use the default value).

Users will find peace of mind knowing the content is backed by the same thorough, unbiased editorial process as all Merative Micromedex® solutions.

Once content has been downloaded or updated an internet connection is not required, allowing for access at anytime from anywhere.
The app is part of the Merative Micromedex Medication Management apps bundle, which includes Micromedex Drug Interactions and Micromedex IV Compatibility. The trio is an excellent solution to your on-the-go medication management needs.

Micromedex Drug Reference app contains concise information on 4500+ search terms, covering common needs such as:
• Adult and pediatric dosage
• Adverse effects (separated into “common” and “serious”)
• Drug interactions

As well as:
• Administration
• Black box warnings
• Breast feeding
• Common trade names
• Contraindications
• Dose adjustments
• Generic names, including selected combination products
• How supplied
• Indications (differentiated as “FDA labeled” and “non-FDA labeled”)
• Mechanism of action
• Monitoring
• Precautions
• Pregnancy category
• Therapeutic class
